name: Rebilly
summary: Rebilly charges 1% of successfully collected revenue on top of a monthly plan, $15 for Basic or $125 for Pro, with a 30-day free trial. It retries declined payments, runs an Account Updater for cards on file, and sends declined and past due notices through its automations.

facts.text: The renewals page says Rebilly can automatically and intelligently retry declined payments and keep card-on-file data updated with Account Updater.
Customer notices are set up through billing events, including Renewal invoice payment declined and Invoice past due.
Rebilly will only charge for invoices that are marked as paid, not for each payment attempt.
The pricing page states prices in USD and says developers can ask for a permanent sandbox account.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: One gateway account. The page lists $0 for transaction fees. The 30-day trial needs no credit card

plans.name: Pro

volumeFee.basis: of revenue successfully collected, with volume discounts

plans.notes: Up to 10 gateway accounts and a full rules engine. The revenue fee is 20% lower from $100,000 a month, 30% lower from $1 million, 40% lower from $10 million and 50% lower from $50 million

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited gateway accounts and custom integrations

hiddenCosts: 3D Secure authentication costs $0.05 per attempted authentication on all plans.
For average transactions above $100, the page suggests asking Rebilly about a cap on the fee per paid invoice.
